correctness.rationale: Walsh diagonalization gives all radial kernel entries; the strictly positive denominator and exact listed factorizations prove the full Q7 positivity window. Descartes sign variations and rational brackets prove uniqueness and ordering of roots. Direct shortest-path Taylor analysis yields positive leading entries through dimension six (including the special zero degree-six term) and the negative -(35/12)h^7 seven-distance term for every larger cube. The included stdlib integer/rational checker executed successfully and exactly reconstructed critical identities; no finite experiment substitutes for a universal proof.

value.rationale: A canonical reversible heat flow can lose positivity at arbitrarily small positive step sizes, regain it on a sharply classified bounded interval, and lose it again. Its endpoint nevertheless stays symmetric, positive definite, and mass-preserving. Complete exact graph-specific algebraic cutoffs and the dimension-seven boundary are informative benchmarks for rational time integrators that are not supplied by general absolute-monotonicity impossibility theorems or directed small-state witnesses.
